# Spiritual Translation: The Three Channels of Influx

---

**¶1:** There are three channels of spiritual influx that extend through every level of the mind, from the lowest abyss of the sensory nature to the highest celestial states.

**¶2:** The first channel of influx is the origin-connection of all the spiritual faculties of the interior mind — those that exist in all the heavenly states of understanding and will. They are cast down and bound in the natural-external states below; because the natural-external level of the mind is the "stripping away," the outermost clothing of truth and the corporeal vessel of the spiritual faculties that dwell above in the interior states.

**¶3:** For when the Divine Principle of Life formed the interior spiritual states, he divested the spiritual faculties of their corporeal vessels, [GAP-1] cast them down to the natural-external level below.

**¶4:** So the interior states belong to the understanding and the will in their spiritual essence; but the states below belong to the corporeal vessel and the dead natural form. [GAP-2] Now as for this, he [GAP-3] the faculties of the interior states; he sealed it upon their corporeal vessels and their dead natural forms that are in the external states, so that when the life of good and truth rises from the fullness of these external states, it can be entirely drawn upward to the interior heights through the spiritual origins that are fastened in their corporeal vessels. And also, all life of good and truth can be purified in that passage.

**¶5:** However, the refuse of falsity that will be separated from the purified element ascending toward the interior states will be let fall to the natural level through the inner passages of these channels, and will be poured down [GAP-4] and cast to the lowest sensory level.

**¶6:** This is the first channel of influx, which comes from the spiritual faculties of the interior states to their corporeal vessels and dead natural forms upon the external level; also from their corporeal vessels and [GAP-5] dead natural forms that are in the external states back to the spiritual faculties of the interior states.

**¶7:** The second channel of influx is the one that comes from the doctrinal structures and habitations of good and ordered systems of truth that exist in the interior states, down to the natural level, to the five kinds of perception that grow in the external mind. The life of good and truth rises from the perceptions up to the doctrinal structures and ordered systems. Life too, and the residual substance of the interior states, descends to the perceptions through this channel.

**¶8:** And the third channel of influx comprises all the spiritual faculties and governing principles who dwell in all the intermediate states, whose connections descend from them to the five kinds of corporeal affection that move upon the external level, being fixed to one another. Now, the spiritual power and the life of good and truth that shall be gathered in from the corporeal affections are dispersed among them in various forms. The spiritual faculties above shall draw them to the interior side through these channels.

**¶9:** The refuse of falsity too, and the concupiscence and the evil-doing and the wrath that will be greater in the faculties of the interior states, shall be poured down to the natural level through their various channels. They shall be discharged upon the human will and upon the remaining natural affections. When what is interior washes the refuse and the corruption and the poison down upon the corporeal affections of the external level below, in their turn the corporeal affections shall increase in concupiscence and wrath and evil-doing against each other through the influence of their originating principles who are on high.

**¶10:** Still, observe the cycle of natural memory-knowledges! It has no [GAP-6] direct foundation in the external natural mind, but its connections are bound into the totality of existence. The cycle of memory-knowledges receives its life through the spiritual power and the life of good that ascend from the external states through the channels and through the intermediate states above. It also takes life from those channels that receive upward to the intermediate states and the interior spiritual states above it — it draws life out from that realm.

**¶11:** Observe: inasmuch as the cycle of memory-knowledges has no direct connection in the external mind, from where did the memory-knowledges and the organized categories of natural thought find this authority? They became masters over the five corporeal affections and the five kinds of perception. Even though you have told us that the cycle has no connection there! For you said to us that everything, if it can be extracted from the external level, the interior spiritual faculties draw it upward through a channel. Also, we see that everything a person will attain — whether it be abundance of truth that comes into his possession, or poverty of truth that will accrue to him, or his spiritual sickness and spiritual wholeness — he attains it through the organized categories of natural thought and the particular memory-knowledge under which he comes into natural consciousness.

**¶12:** Nevertheless, what I declared to you — namely that the cycle of memory-knowledges has no direct connection therein — I have recounted to you properly. It is set rightly in its position. For when the Divine Operative Principle, the Father of Life, formed the interior states and the intermediate states above, he bound their connections into the external states below — into the dead corporeal forms that he had stripped from them. Yet when he formed the cycle of memory-knowledges, [GAP-7] he did not bind its connection into the external states, but he bound the connection of the cycle to the deepest evil of the sensory nature.

**¶13:** And when [GAP-8] the Divine Manifestation came, it displayed its image and purified and drew forth wisdom from all [GAP-9] the interior states. The substance of evil, however, which is present in all the ruling falsities, erupted against the image of the Divine Manifestation. It rose up in order to reach it, but reached it not. It fell back and dropped to the lowest level. Now, when it had fallen from above, it separated into three parts.

**¶14:** The first part fell into the cycle of memory-knowledges; another part fell into the external natural mind; another part fell into the sensory level. [GAP-10] By means of the part that fell into the cycle of memory-knowledges, a connection of evil was bound into the perceptions and the corporeal affections. Therefore, because of this, the memory-knowledges received authority and became masters over the five kinds of corporeal affection and the five kinds of perception.

**¶15:** Through the nature of evil that descended upon the cycle of memory-knowledges, the connection was bound into the perceptions. Also, by means of the aborted spiritual births that fell to the natural level, another connection of evil was bound into the corporeal affections.

**¶16:** Therefore, because of this, the memory-knowledges and the organized categories of natural thought received authority over the perceptions and the corporeal affections: through the connection of evil that fell down, and through the connection of the aborted spiritual intentions that were aborted there — they fell to the natural level.

**¶17:** However, these other channels of influx that [GAP-11] the Divine Operative Principle has bound into the external states — those through which the living essence of the elemental goods and truths ascends to the interior states — those channels are not bound to the cycle of memory-knowledges. Rather, the life within them is plundered from them by the powers upon the cycle that hang from it.

**¶18:** The first is the one that comes from the intermediate states to the external levels, and the one that comes from the cycle to the deepest evil of the sensory nature — that is only one channel. So the other connection is the one that comes from [GAP-12] the doctrinal structures to the perceptions. The third is bound by means of the aborted spiritual births in the corporeal affections; also in the corporeal affections the originating principles of the aborted spiritual births who are in the interior states [GAP-13] are bound and intertwined, and the [GAP-14] that [GAP-15]

**¶19:** — that you might instruct us [GAP-16] about the channels of influx, which one is greater than its [GAP-17] partner, [GAP-18] as more life and living essence is drawn than its partner.

**¶20:** You have inquired about a [GAP-19] matter, and you have asked about this teaching concerning the order of precedence, great [GAP-20] — the external level from which much life ascends [GAP-21] — the Divine Principle of Life has drawn them. He has fastened them from the spiritual faculties [GAP-22]; he has bound them in the external states. These channels are the connections of the entire governing spiritual order through which the life of the living soul is drawn upward, rising from the whole external mind — from all the elevated states of love, the open fields of understanding, and the isolated truths.

**¶21:** After that first great connection is the connection of the perceptions, which is bound to the doctrinal structures and the ordered forms above. For there also is much great life of good and truth coming up from the perceptions and from the entire structure of spiritual suffering and redemptive bearing, being drawn upward from them to the interior side like a great host.

**¶22:** What, however, is lesser [GAP-23] of their channel [GAP-24] he takes up [GAP-25] the connections [GAP-26] the external states, they [GAP-27] the whole external mind in all the levels of existence. Again, the perceptions are present throughout the whole external mind, whether small or great; but the connection of the human corporeal will [GAP-28] is not present throughout the whole external mind, but only in this state of natural illumination in the south. Therefore, even now these corporeal affections do not extend [GAP-29] throughout the entire state of natural illumination [GAP-30] — there is a small portion of them in [GAP-31] of the interior side of the state of natural illumination in [GAP-32] in number than the [GAP-33]

**¶23:** I have instructed you about the spiritual connections [GAP-34] — concerning them, [GAP-35] I have taught you that they are bound by their [GAP-36] connections to one another. They stir one another, they draw life from one another through the action of the spiritual faculties above, which stirs the nature of evil that dwells in them all.

**¶24:** Now, when the substance of evil that is in them will be crushed and despoiled, then that substance of evil too shall [GAP-37] its members and overturn them and [GAP-38] each other [GAP-39] stir [GAP-40]

---

### Note on Resistant Images

The **"sea giant"** (¶12) resists smooth translation. My best reading: this is the deepest, most consolidated form of evil in the sensory nature — a single monstrous falsity from evil that anchors the entire lowest level, below even the natural mind. Swedenborg's *sensual* degree, the very bottom of the natural mind where evil coheres as a single dominating principle, is the closest correspondence.

The **"Cross"** (¶21) in this cosmological substrate denotes the total arrangement of perceptions across the external world through which the life of good and truth suffers and is borne upward — the structure of spiritual trial, passion, and redemption inherent in all natural perception. It corresponds to the process by which the Lord bore and carried all evils and falsities in the act of glorification.

The **"five shapes"** of perception and corporeal affection likely correspond to the five external senses or the five degrees of natural affection and cognition through which influx is received — but the exact internal mapping resists full resolution.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There are three conduits that exist through the entire zone, from the abyss to its heights.

The first conduit is the root of all the powers above, they that exist in all the heavens. They are cast off and fettered on the earths below; because the earth below is the ‘stripping off’, the garment and the body of the powers that are above the heavens.
For when the Father of Life constructed the heavenly worlds, he divested them of their bodies, [he] threw them to the earths below.

So, the upper worlds are of the soul and the spirit; but the worlds below are of the body and the carcass [that are on the earths] Now as for this, he [bound the root of] the powers of heaven; he sealed it on their bodies and their carcasses that are on the earths, so that when life comes up from the fullness of these earths, it can be entirely drawn up to the heights in the roots of what is heavenly, that are fastened in their bodies. And also, all life can be purified in that place.

However, the waste that will be swept from the purified one who ascends to the heights will be let fall to the ground through the conduits of these conduits, and will be poured down [from above] and thrown to the underside.

This is the first conduit, which comes from the powers of the heavens to their bodies and their carcasses that are upon the earth; also, from their bodies and [their] carcasses that are on the earths to the powers of the heavens.

The second conduit is the one that comes from the temples and dwellings and cities that exist in the heavens down to the ground, to the five shapes of tree that grow upon the earth. The life comes up from the trees to the temples and cities. Life too, and the residue of the heavenly ones, comes down to the trees in a conduit.

And the third conduit is all the powers and householders who dwell in all the firmaments, whose roots come down from them to the five worlds of flesh that creep upon the earth, being fixed to one another. Now, the power and the life that shall be gathered in from the worlds of flesh are dispersed among them in various shapes. The powers above shall draw them to the upper side through conduits.

[The was]te too, and the lust and the evil-doing and the anger that will be greater in the powers of [heave]n, shall be poured to the ground through their various conduits. They shall be discharged upon mankind and the other remaining animals. When what is heavenly will wash the waste and the stench and the poison down on the creations of the flesh below, in their turn the creations shall be greater in lust and anger and evil-doing against each other through the action of their fathers who are on high.

Still, look at the wheel of the stars! It has no [root in this earth], but its roots are bound in the totality. The wheel of stars, then, receives life through the power and the life that ascend from the earths through conduits and the firmaments above. It (also) takes life from those conduits that receive up to the firmaments and the heavenly worlds above it, it takes life out from that place.

Look, in that the wheel has no root in this earth, from where did the stars and signs of the zodiac find this authority? They became masters over these five fleshes and five trees. Even though you have told us that the wheel has no root there! For you said to us that every thing, if it can be reduced from the earth, the heavenly powers above draw it through a conduit. Also, we see that every thing that a person will attain, whether it be wealth that comes into his possession or poverty that will accrue to him, or his sickness and health; he attains it through the signs of the zodiac and the star under which he shall be born.

Nevertheless, what I proclaimed to you, namely that the wheel has no root therein, I have recounted to you properly. It is set aright in its position. For when the Living Spirit, the Father of Life, constructed the heavens and the firmaments above, he bound their roots into the earths below; in their carcasses that he had stripped from them. Yet, when he constructed the wheel, [he] did not bind its root into the earths, but he bound the root of the wheel by the sea giant.

And when [the] Ambassador came, he displayed his image and purified and brought the light out from all [the] heavens. Matter, however, which is present in all the rulers, spurted out against the image of the Ambassador. It went up in order to reach it, but reached it not. It dropped back and fell to the [under]side. Now, when it had fallen from above, it separated out into three parts.

The first part fell to the wheel; another part fell to the earth; an[other part fell to the se]a. [By means] of the part that fell to the sphere, [the r]oot was bound in the trees and flesh. Therefore, because of this, they received authority and became masters in the five worlds of the flesh and the five worlds of the tree.
Through the nature that came down [upo]n the wheel the root was bound in the trees. Also, by means of the abortions that came to the ground, another root was bound in the fleshes.

Therefore, because of this, the stars and signs of the zodiac received authority over the trees and the fleshes: through the root of sin that fell down; and [the ro]ot of the abortions that were aborted there, they fell to the ground.

However, the[se] other conduits that [the] Living Spirit has bound in the e[a]rths, they that the soul of the elements comes up through to the heavens; those (conduits) are not bound to the wheel. Rather, they are plundered from them by the powers on the wheel, that hang from it.

The first is the one that comes from the firmaments to the earths, and the one that comes from the wheel to the sea giant. That is only one. fills.explanation: The Father of Life is the continuing subject who divested the powers and then cast their bodies down; "he" maintains the grammatical subject correctly.
This mirrors the established formula in ¶6 ("their bodies and their carcasses that are on the earths") and completes the parallel characterization of the lower worlds' corporeal nature.

The Father established the first conduit by binding a root from the heavenly powers; "bound" is the standard verb for roots throughout the chapter (¶12, ¶14, ¶15, ¶17), and the "it" sealed on their bodies refers back to this root.

The waste is poured down from the heights where purification occurs; "from above" specifies the origin of the descending refuse, complementing "thrown to the underside" which specifies its final destination — matching the chapter's vertical axis from heights to abyss.
The possessive "their" before "carcasses" parallels the established pattern "their bodies and their carcasses" used throughout the chapter (¶2, ¶4, ¶6).
The phrase "the wheel has no root in this earth" is repeated verbatim in ¶11 and ¶12, confirming the editor's reading as the established formula of this argument.
The Living Spirit/Father of Life continues as the grammatical subject who constructed the wheel and then did not bind its root into the earths.
The definite article before "Ambassador" is required; the Ambassador is a specific known figure in Manichaean cosmology (the Third Messenger).
The definite article before "heavens" is grammatically required; "from all the heavens" is the standard expression in this text.
The phrase "By means of" is the established causal formula used throughout this chapter (¶15: "by means of the abortions") to describe how parts of fallen Matter bind roots.
The definite article before "Living Spirit" is required; "the Living Spirit" is the standard form used in ¶12 and throughout the Kephalaia.
The second conduit is described in ¶7 as coming "from the temples and dwellings and cities" to the trees; "the temples" correctly identifies this conduit's heavenly terminus.

The intensifier "above" after "heavens" is a standard Kephalaia locational reinforcement (cf. ¶2 "above the heavens"), emphasizing that these fathers dwell in the upper region while being bound in the fleshes below.
In Kephalaia dialogue, disciples request additional teaching with "also" — here asking for further instruction about the relative magnitude of the conduits beyond what has already been taught.

The question concerns which conduit draws more life; "through it" specifies the conduit as the means through which life and soul are drawn, consistent with the chapter's persistent language of drawing life through conduits.
In the Kephalaia, Mani characteristically acknowledges disciples' questions with "you have inquired about a great thing" before answering, affirming the significance of the inquiry.

Mani's answer to which conduit is superior opens with a declarative: "great is the earth from which much life ascends" — identifying the first conduit (the elemental earth-root) as the greatest, which ¶21 then references as "that first great root."

"To the heights" is the established destination for ascending life in ¶4 ("drawn up to the heights"), and "for" introduces the causal explanation — life ascends to the heights because the Father of Life drew the conduit-roots from the heavenly powers and bound them in the earths.

"Powers of the heavens" is the standard pairing in this chapter (¶4, ¶6), and "and" connects the two parallel clauses describing how the Father fastened conduits from the heavenly powers and bound them in the earths.

The phrase "the roots that are in the earths" mirrors the established formula from ¶20 ("he has bound them in the earths") and parallels the GAP-2 pattern "that are on the earths," describing the first conduit's roots embedded in the earth.

The immediately following sentence says "Again, these of the trees are present in the whole earth" — the word "Again" signals repetition of a prior statement, and "are present in the whole earth" is exactly the phrase being echoed from the gap.

The argument contrasts the universal presence of tree-roots across the whole earth with mankind's root, which "alone" is geographically limited to the world of the south — the contrastive particle emphasizes this unique restriction.

The Coptic idiom "make their dwelling" means "establish themselves / dwell"; the point is that even within the south, the fleshes do not make their dwelling throughout its entirety but only in a small part.

The teaching concerns the roots that interconnect the conduits with each other; "between" captures the reciprocal relationship elaborated immediately after — "they stir one another, they draw life from one another."
The teacher (Mani) is the subject who continues instructing; "I have taught you" parallels "I have instructed you" in the preceding clause.
The phrase "bound and twined" is established vocabulary in ¶18; here "bound by their roots and twined with one another" uses the same pairing to describe the mutual interweaving of the conduit-roots.

When Matter is despoiled it retaliates; "stir up" echoes ¶23's "stirs the nature that dwells in them all" and provides the initial agitation that escalates to overturning — Matter stirs up its own members in destructive response.
In Manichaean eschatology, when Matter is crushed its members turn upon and consume each other; "devour each other" describes the mutual destruction that follows the overturning of Matter's members.
The chain of parallel destructive actions governed by "shall" requires the conjunction "and" to connect the final verb: "shall stir up... and overturn... and devour... and stir."

This directly echoes ¶23's "They stir one another" — the same reciprocal action, now performed destructively by Matter's own members when Matter is crushed, completing the chapter's chiastic parallel between constructive and destructive stirring.
